note: Small private campground next to Carhenge north of Alliance, with views across open country. All pull-through sites on a slight hill in full sun; most need side-to-side levelling, and hookups are spread out at many sites. Self check-in kiosk, pay cash in an envelope. Full-hookup, water-only and no-hookup sites, 3rd consecutive night half price. Campers report no bathhouse; porta-johns for tents. --Claude
summary: Operator Wix pages confirm full hookups 50/30 A, free WiFi, open all year, self check-in; rates $35 FHU / $27 water-only / $17 no-hookup (undated on the page, dated by five RV Life stays Aug 2025-Sep 2026 at $35). Gate passes: $35 <= $50, site + phone, Google 4.2 (46), RV Life 7.91/10 over only 18 ratings (under 25, no drop). Protected fees 35-35 left as is, but the base should be $17 (no-hookup RV site) - flagged. Not waterfront, pin OK.
